content.text: The company wants uni_owns_option_to_assign. If they exercise the option, the university loses ownership and publication rights could be at risk. I should counter with uni_owns_option_to_licence which still lets them commercialize but preserves our ability to publish and build on the work. I already proposed that in round 2. Let me stick with uni_owns_option_to_licence and accept everything else.
